# Distribution worklist — 2026-07-30

_Generated by `zer0-distribute cater`. The audience-evidence counterpart to `.cms/worklists/<date>.md`: that one says what is wrong with the content, this one says what to write next. Rankings use the author's own aggregate post statistics; no member-level data is read or stored._

## Lane A — Distribute what already exists

Content that scores well and has never been published off-site. No writing required, so this is the cheapest work on the list.

| # | Health | Fresh | Collection | File |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 70 | aging | corp | `pages/_posts/corp/g.md` |
| 2 | — | fresh | tech | `pages/_posts/tech/d.md` |

## Lane B — Write more of what landed

Topics at or above the median engagement rate, each with at least 2 posts behind it. Evidence, not a guarantee.

| Topic | Posts | Impressions | Engagement rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| tech | 2 | 12,345 | 7.50% |
| corp | 2 | 2,000 | 2.75% |

## Lane C — Say the quiet part

Topics below the median. Worth naming, because the alternative is repeating them by default. Low engagement is not the same as low value — a compliance post can matter and still be unpopular.

| Topic | Posts | Impressions | Engagement rate |
|---|---|---|---|
| muses | 2 | 3,000 | 1.00% |

## Lane D — Refresh what worked

Content that earned engagement and has since gone stale. Updating a page that already found its readers beats starting from nothing.

| 80 | stale | `pages/_posts/muses/e.md` |
